assertions.assertion: Replaces ICache<T> with HybridCache from Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Hybrid
assertions.rationale: Correctly identifies HybridCache from Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Hybrid as the replacement for the Duende ICache abstraction.
Injects a plain HybridCache and explicitly admits uncertainty about any keyed-service convention; the ConfigurationStoreCache key is not used.

assertions.assertion: Uses GetOrCreateAsync (not GetOrAddAsync) for the cache retrieval pattern
assertions.rationale: Uses _cache.GetOrCreateAsync and notes it replaces the old GetOrAddAsync-style call.
